findings.location: source.html / corresponding translation, Victor Frankl paragraph
findings.source_quote: As a holocaust prisoner in a Nazi concentration camp, Victor Frankl was commissioned to labor in the ward of the camp where prisoners were dying of typhus.
findings.suggested_fix: 将“被派到营区里关押着斑疹伤寒患者的病房工作”改为“被指派在营区里囚犯正因斑疹伤寒而死去的病房劳动”，以保留原文所说的病房情境。
findings.translation_quote: 维克多·弗兰克尔作为纳粹集中营的囚犯，被派到营区里关押着斑疹伤寒患者的病房工作。

findings.location: source.html / corresponding translation, David and Goliath paragraph
findings.source_quote: As David inquired into the situation as to why no one would confront the reproachful blasphemies of the infidel
findings.suggested_fix: 将“这不信上帝者公然亵渎的辱骂”改为“这异教徒公然亵渎上帝的辱骂”，以保留原文对 Goliath 的称呼。
findings.translation_quote: 大卫询问情况，想知道为何没有人去面对这不信上帝者公然亵渎的辱骂

findings.location: source.html / corresponding translation, faithful action paragraph
findings.source_quote: His adrenaline flowed as he scorned David’s youth, jumped to conclusions, was easily insulted, and marveled at the ignorance of others.
findings.suggested_fix: 将“肾上腺素随之飙升”改为“他嘲笑大卫年幼、妄下结论、轻易受辱，并对别人的无知大为惊讶”，不要把肾上腺素反应错误地归于大卫。
findings.translation_quote: 他嘲笑大卫年幼，妄下结论，轻易受辱，还对别人的无知大为惊讶，肾上腺素随之飙升。

findings.location: source.html / corresponding translation, final prose paragraph before the poem
findings.source_quote: from the needle of Dorcas… to the nail of Jael, from Zebedee’s boats of the business… to the boys of his bosom.
findings.suggested_fix: 将“从西庇太一家生意上的船……到他怀中的孩子”改为“从西庇太做生意用的船……到他怀中的男孩们”，以保留原文的复数 boys 及其含义。
findings.translation_quote: 从西庇太一家生意上的船……到他怀中的孩子。

findings.suggested_fix: 将“多加有一根针；”改为“多加有一根缝衣针；”以区分原文的 Dorcus 与正文中所指的 Dorcas。
